cards.card_text: After these events, King Xerxes honors a man named Haman, son of Hammedatha, the Agagite.
cards.verse_text: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him to a position above all the princes who were with him.

cards.card_text: Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted to destroy them.
cards.verse_text: For Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them and had cast the Pur (that is, the lot) to crush and destroy them.
